items.title: Akamai Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Up Y/Y on Solid Demand
items.summary: AKAM tops Q2 2026 estimates as AI cloud and cybersecurity demand lift revenues, but higher infrastructure investments pressure earnings.

items.title: Cogent Incurs Narrower-Than-Expected Q2 Loss Despite Lower Revenues
items.summary: CCOI beats Q2 earnings estimates despite a revenue miss as weakness in Sprint Wireline and off-net services offset growth in on-net and wavelength offerings.

items.title: VISN Q2 Earnings Miss on License Sales and Memory Costs
items.summary: Vistance's Q2 earnings miss estimates as lower legacy license sales and memory costs pressured results, while DOCSIS 4.0 offers growth potential.

items.title: Optimum's Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates on Revenue Pressure
items.summary: OPTU's Q2 revenues slip amid broadband and video pressure, while mobile growth, margin expansion and network investments offer offsets.

items.title: HubSpot Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Healthy Top-Line Growth
items.summary: HUBS tops Q2 2026 estimates with 20% revenue growth, AI-powered CRM demand and customer gains fueling earnings and a stronger full-year outlook.

items.title: Zillow Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates on Solid Revenue Growth
items.summary: ZG beats Q2 2026 estimates as mortgage and rental growth lift revenues 18%, while its outlook points to continued momentum across key businesses.

items.title: VIAV Q4 Earnings Top Estimates on Data Center, A&D Strength
items.summary: Viavi beats fiscal Q4 earnings and revenue estimates as data center, aerospace and defense demand, and Spirent products fuel growth, with strong Q1'27 guidance.

items.title: MSI Q2 Earnings Top Estimates on Strong Demand, Record Backlog
items.summary: MSI beat Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as strong demand and record orders drove backlog to a second-quarter high, prompting another 2026 outlook increase.
